title: Protomodularity of cocommutative Hopf monoids in duoidal categories and quasitriangular Hopf algebras
summary: In this work, we extend the protomodularity of the category of cocommutative Hopf algebras to the quasitriangular setting. Every quasitriangular Hopf algebra admits a minimal quasitriangular Hopf subalgebra and, as we show, can be regarded as a cocommutative bimonoid in the tensor-braided duoidal category of bimodules over it. This leads us to investigate protomodularity in the broader context of Hopf monoids in duoidal categories.
